title: m5stack/esphome #1: Chain ENV/DLight/IMU components build and run in a host harness; alarm-only configs never poll and CI lacks component tests

firmware.name: ESPHome build from the PR head

execution.environment: macOS arm64, Python 3.13.15 venv, ESPHome 2026.11.0-dev from the PR checkout, ESP-IDF 5.5.6, ESPHome host target bound to a pseudo-terminal Chain simulator

checks.name: esphome_config_valid
checks.evidence: esphome config on a three-node YAML (all sensors, alarms, six outputs) reports 'Configuration is valid!'

checks.name: esp32_idf_build
checks.evidence: esphome compile esp32dev/esp-idf 5.5.6 succeeds, 725079 bytes, Flash 39.5 %, RAM 27.3 % (evidence/build-esp-idf.txt)

checks.name: protocol_crosscheck
checks.evidence: command codes, payload order, units and event masks match m5stack/M5Chain@277dcfe8 (evidence/protocol-crosscheck.txt)

checks.name: boot_settings_payloads
checks.evidence: host run emits 0x36/0xE3/0xE5/0xE7/0xE9/0xE1 for ENV, 0x33/0x31/0xE1 for DLight, 0xE3/0xE5/0xE1 for IMU with the documented byte order (evidence/host-runtime.txt)

checks.name: readings_decode
checks.evidence: synthetic answers decode to 23.50 C / 45 % / 1013.2 hPa / 12.34 m / 1234 lx / 9.80665 m/s2 / 27.50 C (evidence/host-runtime.txt)

checks.name: event_alarm_mapping
checks.evidence: 0xE0 payloads 010f/000f, 0310/0410/0010, 00/02/01/03 drive the ENV temperature, IMU motion/rotation/temperature and DLight Dark/Bright entities on and off (evidence/host-runtime.txt)

checks.name: alarm_only_initial_state
checks.evidence: host-alarmonly.yaml: 7 configuration frames, 0 reads, 0 state publications in 13 s; binary sensors stay unknown (evidence/alarm-only.txt)

checks.name: component_test_yamls
checks.evidence: no tests/components/m5_chain_{env,dlight,imu}/ while all 14 existing chain components have common.yaml + test.esp32-idf.yaml

checks.name: codeowners_check
checks.evidence: script/build_codeowners.py --check reports 'CODEOWNERS file is not up to date'; ci.yml:238 runs it (evidence/codeowners-check.txt)

checks.name: virtual_device_validation
checks.evidence: local Device Service has 36 profiles, none is a Chain controller or Chain peripheral; no Chain model exists

checks.name: hardware_validation
checks.evidence: no Chain Captain, Chain ENV, DLight or IMU on the bench

checks.name: dlight_interrupt_vs_polling
checks.evidence: vendor library documents lux acquisition only outside the threshold band when the interrupt is enabled; needs hardware confirmation

evidence.description: config validation and ESP-IDF build results with sizes
PR constants against m5stack/M5Chain ENV, DLight and IMU headers/sources
request frames, synthetic readings and entity transitions from the host run
alarm-only run: seven configuration frames, no reads, no states
generated setup code showing the setter order and the duplicate set_update_interval call

notes: Evidence class is host-level test plus code-level verification; nothing was run on a virtual M5Stack device or on physical Chain hardware.
The harness replies in about 140 ms because of ESPHome host UART read pacing, so 'Slow response' lines are an artefact of the simulator; poll intervals were raised to 2 s to avoid starvation.
Findings are stated as review comments only; no change was pushed to the PR and no issue was closed.
